messages:
samir: deploy-bot flagged canary quorum failures for chart=redwood-search v3.14.2 in eu-west-1; 2/5 canaries degraded, change window ends in 45m. thoughts on rollback vs pin?

deploy-bot: automated-detection: canary-health=DEGRADED, metric=latency_p95, threshold_exceeded=true, suggested_action=quorum-fallback-pin -> previous-chart v3.14.1
maria: ugh. timeline? did the canary include the new db connection pool change in values?
samir: yes, values override pool.max=150 applied in the canary slice. primary cluster is fine so far but canaries show OOM spikes on one node.
tj: can we scope to just rollback the canary slice? helm doesn't do that atm, we'd either rollback the release or pin values for next rollout. alternative: scale canary replica to 1 and re-run readiness checks.
alyssa: we should avoid global rollback if only canaries failing and control plane is healthy. proposes: pause rollout, pin chart to 3.14.1 for auto rollouts, and open a hotfix PR to revert pool change.
jeff: agree with pause + hotfix. create release note entry so PMs know we held. Also need to update deploy-bot policy to not auto-rollforward when canary quorum < 3.
maria: actionable steps? I'll open the hotfix PR and include perf test run.
samir: plan then: 1) pause the release rollout (deploy-bot pause <release>) 2) pin auto-rollouts to v3.14.1 in release-config 3) open hotfix PR to revert pool.max to 100 4) run canary smoke with stress perf after PR merged 5) notify customers via release notes if rollout delayed >1h
tj: snippets: to pause ->
```
# pause canary via deploy bot
/rollout pause redwood-search --scope=canary
```
then to pin:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap release-config -p '{"data": {"redwood-search":"v3.14.1"}}'
```
alyssa: I'll draft the release note blurb: "Canary rollout for redwood-search v3.14.2 paused due to canary memory regressions; holding to investigate. No impact to production traffic."
deploy-bot: action accepted: rollout paused by samir. Pins requested: release-config patch queued.
samir: I'll kick off the hotfix PR and tag @maria for the perf run. moving to incident channel if we see production impact.
jeff: thumbs for PR and notes. leave a comment with rollback commands if we decide to fully rollback later:
```
helm rollback redwood-search 42 --namespace=prod
```
maria: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4382 includes revert of pool.max and a canary perf job. starting perf now. updates here in 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
samir: thanks. keeping the change window owner tag on until cleared.
